title: Will BTC trade above $150,000 before December 31, 2026?
description: Resolves to YES if the approved oracle reports a BTC/USD price >= $150,000 at any valid observation before the deadline.
resolution_rules: Based on official Chainlink BTC/USD price feed on Robinhood Chain.

title: Will the Fed cut rates at the next FOMC meeting?
description: Resolves to YES if the Federal Reserve announces a rate cut at the upcoming FOMC meeting.
resolution_rules: Based on the official press release from the Federal Reserve Board.

title: Will AAPL reference price close above $250 this Friday?
description: Resolves to YES if the AAPL Stock Token reference price closes strictly above $250 on this Friday's trading session.
resolution_rules: Based on the official Robinhood Chain AAPL reference price oracle at market close.

title: Will US CPI YoY print below 3.0%?
description: Resolves to YES if the next US Consumer Price Index (CPI) year-over-year report is below 3.0%.
resolution_rules: Based on the official data release by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.

title: Will ETH outperform BTC this week?
description: Resolves to YES if the percentage gain of ETH/USD is strictly greater than BTC/USD over the 7-day period ending Sunday at 23:59 UTC.
resolution_rules: Based on Chainlink price feeds for ETH and BTC on Robinhood Chain.

title: Will unemployment exceed 4.5%?
description: Resolves to YES if the next U.S. unemployment rate report prints strictly greater than 4.5%.
resolution_rules: Based on the official data release by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.

title: Will TSLA reference price gain >5% after earnings?
description: Resolves to YES if the TSLA Stock Token reference price closes more than 5% higher on the day of its next earnings release compared to the previous day's close.
resolution_rules: Based on the official Robinhood Chain TSLA reference price oracle.

title: Will SOL close above $300?
description: Resolves to YES if the SOL/USD price oracle reports a price >= $300 at any point before the end of the year.
resolution_rules: Based on the official Chainlink SOL/USD price feed.

title: Will NVDA outperform SPY this week?
description: Resolves to YES if the NVDA Stock Token reference price percentage change is strictly greater than the SPY Stock Token reference price percentage change for the week.
resolution_rules: Based on official Robinhood Chain reference price oracles for NVDA and SPY.

title: Will Donald Trump win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
description: Resolves to YES if Donald Trump is elected President of the United States in the 2028 election.
resolution_rules: Based on official election results confirmed by the Electoral College.

title: Will Real Madrid win the Champions League 2026/2027?
description: Resolves to YES if Real Madrid wins the UEFA Champions League title for the 2026/2027 season.
resolution_rules: Based on the official UEFA results.

title: Will OpenAI release GPT-5 before July 2027?
description: Resolves to YES if OpenAI officially announces and releases a model named GPT-5 or equivalent next-generation flagship model before July 1, 2027.
resolution_rules: Based on official announcements from OpenAI's blog or press releases.

title: Will GTA VI be delayed to 2028?
description: Resolves to YES if Rockstar Games officially announces a delay for Grand Theft Auto VI, pushing its release date into the year 2028.
resolution_rules: Based on official announcements from Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

title: Will T1 win League of Legends Worlds 2026?
description: Resolves to YES if the T1 organization wins the LoL World Championship in 2026.
resolution_rules: Based on official Riot Games tournament results.

title: Will CS2 reach 2M concurrent players by end of 2026?
description: Resolves to YES if Counter-Strike 2 reaches a peak concurrent player count of 2,000,000 or more on Steam before December 31, 2026.
resolution_rules: Based on official SteamDB peak player data.

title: Will Taylor Swift release Reputation (Taylor's Version) in 2026?
description: Resolves to YES if Taylor Swift officially releases the re-recorded album 'Reputation (Taylor's Version)' before December 31, 2026.
resolution_rules: Based on official announcements and releases on Spotify/Apple Music.

title: Will the Lakers win the NBA Championship in 2027?
description: Resolves to YES if the Los Angeles Lakers win the NBA Finals for the 2026-2027 season.
resolution_rules: Based on official NBA championship results.

title: Will Max Verstappen win the 2026 F1 World Championship?
description: Resolves to YES if Max Verstappen secures the Formula 1 World Drivers' Championship in the 2026 season.
resolution_rules: Based on official FIA Formula 1 final standings.

title: Will the UK re-enter the EU before 2030?
description: Resolves to YES if the United Kingdom officially rejoins the European Union as a member state before January 1, 2030.
resolution_rules: Based on official treaties ratified by both the UK Parliament and the EU.

title: Will the S&P 500 close above 6500 by end of 2026?
description: Resolves to YES if the S&P 500 index closes at or above 6,500 points on any trading day before December 31, 2026.
resolution_rules: Based on official closing prices published by the NYSE/Cboe.

title: Will Gold (XAU) reach $3000 an ounce in 2026?
description: Resolves to YES if the spot price of Gold (XAU/USD) reaches or exceeds $3,000 at any point during 2026.
resolution_rules: Based on official LBMA Gold Price or major commodities exchanges.

title: Will Apple release a foldable iPhone by 2026?
description: Resolves to YES if Apple Inc. officially announces or releases a smartphone with a foldable screen before December 31, 2026.
resolution_rules: Based on official Apple press releases or events.

title: Will Ethereum flip Bitcoin in Market Cap by 2030?
description: Resolves to YES if the total market capitalization of Ethereum (ETH) strictly exceeds that of Bitcoin (BTC) at any point before January 1, 2030.
resolution_rules: Based on official CoinMarketCap or CoinGecko market cap data.
